class S2D4P.core.core_abc.GenerativeContext(module: moduleABC | None = None)

Bases: object

Describe the generative behavior of a model module.

The context distinguishes generator-based stochastic output sampling from generative modeling architectures such as conditional variational autoencoders.

Parameters:

module (moduleABC | None) – Model module from which generative settings are determined. If None, both generative flags are disabled.

S2D4P.core.optimization module

class S2D4P.core.optimization.CosineAnnealingLRScheduler(config: LRSchedulerConfig, optimizer: Optimizer)

Bases: object

Step-based cosine-annealing learning-rate scheduler.

An optional linear warmup increases the learning rate from a small fraction of its configured initial value before cosine annealing begins. After the configured duration, the minimum learning rate can optionally be held fixed.

Parameters:

  • config (LRSchedulerConfig) – Configuration defining warmup, annealing duration, and minimum learning rate.

  • optimizer (torch.optim.Optimizer) – Optimizer whose learning rate is controlled.

load_state_dict(state_dict)

Restore learning-rate scheduler state.

Both the current state format containing scheduler and num_steps and a direct underlying scheduler state dictionary are supported.

Parameters:

state_dict (dict) – Saved learning-rate scheduler state.

Raises:

RuntimeError – If the underlying scheduler has not been built.

state_dict()

Return the learning-rate scheduler state.

Returns:

Underlying scheduler state and number of scheduler steps performed.

Return type:

dict

Raises:

RuntimeError – If the underlying scheduler has not been built.

step()

Advance the learning-rate schedule by one optimizer step.

Before total_steps is reached, the underlying schedule advances normally. Afterward, the learning rate is either fixed at min_lr or the underlying scheduler continues according to hold_min_lr.

Raises:

RuntimeError – If the underlying scheduler has not been built.

class S2D4P.core.optimization.LRSchedulerConfig(min_lr: float = 0.0, warmup_epochs: int = 0, total_epochs: int | None = None, hold_min_lr: bool = True)

Bases: object

Configuration for a cosine-annealing learning-rate schedule.

The schedule can optionally begin with a linear warmup and hold the minimum learning rate after the configured training duration.

Parameters:

  • min_lr (float) – Minimum learning rate reached by cosine annealing.

  • warmup_epochs (int) – Number of epochs used for linear learning-rate warmup.

  • total_epochs (int | None) – Total number of epochs represented by the schedule.

  • hold_min_lr (bool) – Whether to keep the learning rate fixed at min_lr after the scheduled number of optimization steps.

build(optimizer: Optimizer, num_batches: int, gradient_accumulation_steps: int = 1)

Build a step-based cosine-annealing learning-rate scheduler.

Epoch counts are converted to optimizer-step counts using the number of batches and gradient accumulation interval.

Parameters:

  • optimizer (torch.optim.Optimizer) – Optimizer whose learning rate is scheduled.

  • num_batches (int) – Number of training batches in each epoch.

  • gradient_accumulation_steps (int) – Number of batches accumulated before each optimizer step.

Returns:

Configured learning-rate scheduler.

Return type:

CosineAnnealingLRScheduler

Raises:

ValueError – If the total epoch count, batch count, or gradient accumulation interval is nonpositive, or if the warmup duration is not shorter than the total schedule duration.

hold_min_lr: bool = True
min_lr: float = 0.0
total_epochs: int = None
warmup_epochs: int = 0

class S2D4P.core.registery.Registery

Bases: object

Registry for named classes.

Registered classes are assigned their registry name through the _type attribute and can later be instantiated from optional configuration data.

available()

Return the names of all registered classes.

Returns:

Names currently available in the registry.

Return type:

list[str]

get(name, config=None)

Retrieve and instantiate a registered class.

Dictionary configurations are passed as keyword arguments to the registered class. Dataclass types are constructed using strict field matching. Other configuration values are passed as a single positional argument.

Parameters:

  • name (str) – Name identifying the registered class.

  • config (Any) – Configuration used to construct the registered class.

Returns:

Instance of the registered class.

Return type:

Any

Raises:

ValueError – If name is not registered.

Create a decorator that registers a class under a name.

S2D4P.core.trainer module

class S2D4P.core.trainer.Trainer(config: TrainerConfig, train_data_loader: Dataloader, module: moduleABC, optimizer: OptimizerWrapper, max_epochs: int, validation_data_loader: Dataloader | None = None)

Bases: object

Manage model training, validation, optimization, and checkpointing.

The trainer supports distributed training, mixed precision, gradient accumulation, gradient clipping, validation-based early stopping, metric aggregation, checkpoint resumption, and learning-rate scheduling.

Parameters:

  • config (TrainerConfig) – Configuration controlling training behavior.

  • train_data_loader (Dataloader) – Data loader providing training batches.

  • module (moduleABC) – Model module to train.

  • optimizer (OptimizerWrapper) – Optimizer and optional learning-rate scheduler.

  • max_epochs (int) – Maximum number of training epochs.

  • validation_data_loader (Dataloader | None) – Optional data loader providing validation batches.

log_root(level: int, msg: str, *args)

Log a message from the root process.

Parameters:

  • level (int) – Logging level used for the message.

  • msg (str) – Message to log or print.

  • args (Any) – Positional arguments passed to the configured logger.

property raw_module

Restore training state from a checkpoint.

Model, optimizer, scheduler, gradient-scaler, training progress, early-stopping state, and available metric histories are restored.

Parameters:

  • path (str | Path | None) – Path to the checkpoint file. If None, best.pt in the configured checkpoint directory is used.

  • strict (bool) – Whether checkpoint model parameters must exactly match the current module state dictionary.

Returns:

Loaded checkpoint contents.

Return type:

dict

Raises:

FileNotFoundError – If the requested checkpoint file does not exist.

setup_distributed(distributed: Distributed, logger: Logger, log_every_n_epochs: int = 1, save_checkpoint: bool = True)

Configure the trainer for distributed execution.

The model is wrapped with distributed data parallel execution when needed, mixed-precision scaling and metric aggregators are initialized, and an existing best checkpoint is restored when available.

Parameters:

  • distributed (Distributed) – Distributed runtime containing device, rank, local-rank, and world-size information.

  • logger (logging.Logger) – Logger used for training status messages.

  • log_every_n_epochs (int) – Number of epochs between metric logging and plot updates.

  • save_checkpoint (bool) – Whether training checkpoints are saved.

Raises:

RuntimeError – If the model is not located on the device assigned to the trainer.

train()

Run the model training loop.

Each epoch performs training, distributed metric aggregation, optional validation, checkpointing, metric logging, and early-stopping evaluation. Outstanding accumulated gradients are handled after the final epoch when necessary.

Raises:

RuntimeError – If distributed trainer setup has not been completed.

class S2D4P.core.trainer.TrainerConfig(beta_finder: BetaAnnealing | None = None, earlystoppingbuffer: float = inf, minimum_validation_improvement_percentage: float = 0.02, gradient_accumulation_steps: int = 1, mixed_precision: bool = True, grad_clip: float | None = None)

Bases: object

Configuration for model training.

Parameters:

  • beta_finder (BetaAnnealing | None) – Beta-annealing schedule used to weight the Kullback-Leibler divergence during cVAE training.

  • earlystoppingbuffer (float) – Number of consecutive validation epochs without sufficient improvement allowed before early stopping.

  • minimum_validation_improvement_percentage (float) – Minimum fractional improvement in validation loss required for an epoch to be considered improved.

  • gradient_accumulation_steps (int) – Number of batches over which gradients are accumulated before each optimizer update.

  • mixed_precision (bool) – Whether automatic mixed-precision training is enabled.

  • grad_clip (float | None) – Maximum gradient norm applied before optimizer updates. If None, gradient clipping is disabled.

Release unused Python and CUDA memory.

Runs Python garbage collection and, when CUDA is available, clears cached CUDA memory and collects unused inter-process CUDA allocations.

class S2D4P.core.writer.Writer(config: WriterConfig, inference_data_loader: Dataloader, train_dataloader_config: TrainDataloaderConfig, module: moduleABC, post_processor: PreprocessingPipeline, output_dir: Path | str)

Bases: object

Run inference and aggregate prediction outputs.

The writer coordinates distributed prediction, extraction of training-derived model statistics, temporary batch output storage, postprocessing, and year-by-year NetCDF aggregation.

Parameters:

  • config (WriterConfig) – Configuration controlling prediction and aggregation behavior.

  • inference_data_loader (Dataloader) – Data loader providing inference batches.

  • train_dataloader_config (TrainDataloaderConfig) – Training data-loader configuration used to reconstruct training or validation loaders when statistics are required.

  • module (moduleABC) – Trained model module used for inference.

  • post_processor (PreprocessingPipeline) – Fitted preprocessing pipeline used to reconstruct and inverse transform predictions.

  • output_dir (Path | str) – Directory in which inference outputs are stored.

aggregate_predictions_to_netcdf(do_post_process: bool = True)

Aggregate temporary prediction files into final NetCDF outputs.

Aggregation is performed only by the root process after distributed ranks are synchronized. The fitted output preprocessing pipeline can optionally be disabled.

Parameters:

do_post_process (bool) – Whether predictions are reconstructed and inverse transformed with the fitted output preprocessing pipeline.

aggregate_train_stats(stats: dict[str, RunningCovariance])

Aggregate and save training-derived covariance statistics.

Running statistics are reduced across distributed processes. The root process then calculates each mean and covariance matrix and saves the results.

Parameters:

stats (dict[str, RunningCovariance]) – Running covariance accumulators keyed by statistic name.

build_train_loader(from_validation: bool = False, return_metadata: bool = False, shuffle: bool | None = None)

Parameters:

  • from_validation (bool) – Whether to build the validation loader instead of the training loader.

  • return_metadata (bool) – Whether samples include their sampling-coordinate metadata.

  • shuffle (bool | None) – Whether samples are shuffled.

  • num_output_sampling (int) – Number of output samples generated for each prediction.

  • get_trained_model_stats_from_validation (bool) – Whether model statistics required for inference are estimated from the validation dataset instead of the training dataset.

  • aggregate_only (bool) – Whether to skip prediction and aggregate previously saved temporary prediction files only.

  • predict_only (bool) – Whether to generate temporary prediction files without aggregating them into final NetCDF outputs.

predictor: DeterministicPredictorConfig | cVAEPredictorConfig | None = None
S2D4P.core.writer.aggregate_predictions(post_processor: PreprocessingPipeline | None, output_dir: Path, output_ensemble: bool = False, logger_function: callable | None = None, cleanup_temp: bool = True, init_time_dim: str = 'time', lead_time_dim: str = 'lead_time', optional_sample_dimensions: tuple[str, ...] = ('ensembles',))

Aggregate temporary batch predictions into yearly NetCDF files.

Temporary files from all ranks are scanned to determine available initialization times. Predictions are combined first by initialization time and lead time, then by initialization year. Coordinates are sorted, duplicates are removed from lead times, and optional preprocessing is inverted before the yearly datasets are saved.

Parameters:

  • post_processor (PreprocessingPipeline | None) – Fitted preprocessing pipeline used to reconstruct and inverse transform predictions. If None, prediction channels are converted directly to dataset variables.

  • output_dir (Path) – Directory containing the _temp prediction directory and receiving the final yearly NetCDF files.

  • output_ensemble (bool) – Whether output filenames indicate that predictions contain an output ensemble.

  • logger_function (callable | None) – Optional logging function receiving a logging level and message.

  • cleanup_temp (bool) – Whether temporary prediction files and their directory are removed after successful aggregation.

  • init_time_dim (str) – Name of the initialization-time dimension.

  • lead_time_dim (str) – Name of the lead-time dimension.

  • optional_sample_dimensions (tuple[str, ...]) – Additional sample dimensions sorted and cleaned during aggregation.

Raises:

RuntimeError – If no temporary prediction files are available, required initialization coordinates are missing, no initialization times are present, or lead or initialization times remain non-monotonic after sorting.
